department: Graduate School of Health and Medical Sciences (Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences)

deadline.value: No central deadline: vacant PhD positions are posted on the UCPH job portal, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: Vacant PhD positions can be found in the university job portal.

supervisor.value: You need a supervisor, a project, a workplace and funding in place before you start the application.
supervisor.quote: Before you start your application process, you must have a supervisor, a project, a workplace and a way to fund your study.

also.quote: Your principal supervisor must be employed at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen.

funding.value: You need a funding route (for example employment as a PhD fellow) lined up before you apply, including the tuition fee for all three years.
funding.quote: Before you start your application process, you must have a supervisor, a project, a workplace and a way to fund your study.

also.quote: Tuition fee for all three years must be guaranteed when applying for enrolment.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

toefl_min.value: This school requires TOEFL iBT 83 (or IELTS Academic 6.5).
toefl_min.quote: Students must have a minimum score of 6.5 on IELTS Academic, or 83 on the TOEFL iBT test.

ielts_min.value: This school requires IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (or TOEFL iBT 83).
ielts_min.quote: Students must have a minimum score of 6.5 on IELTS Academic, or 83 on the TOEFL iBT test.

english_waiver.value: A BSc or MSc taught in English can be documented instead of a test, with documentation enclosed; the page does not name India.
english_waiver.quote: You can document that you have completed a BSc or MSc education where English was the language of instruction (please enclose documentation with your application).

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Separate graduate school from SCIENCE with its own English rules. Its tuition fee page states DKK 50,000 per year (150,000 for three years) from 1 Jan 2027. Covers biomedical PhDs; neuroscience and other SUND fields were not separately verified.
